sources.entry: eAgronom - Farm management software that uses AI to track, optimize, and make farming more sustainable, with carbon credit integration. #paid

summary.name: eAgronom
summary.one_liner: eAgronom is a sustainability and farm-management company that connects farmers, carbon credit buyers and food companies through soil carbon projects and related tools.
use_cases: Generating extra revenue from soil carbon credits
Sourcing verified soil carbon credits from European farms
Reducing Scope 3 emissions in a food supply chain
Applying inputs by management zone with variable rate application
summary.what_it_does: The page describes eAgronom as a platform serving three groups: farmers (soil health and carbon program participation), carbon credit buyers (sourcing verified soil carbon credits from European farms), and food sector companies (measurable Scope 3 reductions). It states that its CEE soil carbon project is registered under the Verra VM0042 standard with first credits issued. Soil Angel is announced as a tool that automatically detects field operations and turns them into dated, field-level records. The page also mentions a variable rate application feature, though it gives no detail beyond its title. It says it has 2.5M+ hectares on the platform and 3500+ farmers since 2016, and that it works with farmers in 13 countries across Europe and Africa.
notable: Soil carbon project registered under Verra VM0042 with first credits issued
Soil Angel automatically turns detected field operations into dated field-level records
Operates in 13 countries across Europe and Africa, with 2.5M+ hectares and 3500+ farmers on the platform
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; the directory listing marks it as paid
Platform availability beyond the web is not specified on the page
